scope: Proposition 6.2 (Cube-root and fourth-root clocks) of the manuscript “Geometric Programs for Solenoidal Forcing” (preprints/Geometric-Programs-for-Solenoidal-Forcing-September-27-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 376 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1e54090582721ee2), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 16. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Under the hypotheses on W in Lemma 6.1, choose g(t) = (1 + t)q − 1, with q = 1/3 or 1/4, and put β = 1 − q. The resulting force and velocity have bounded mixed derivatives and ∥∂k t Dα x u(t)∥∞ + ∥∂k t Dα x f(t)∥∞ ≤ Ck,α(1 + t)−β for every fixed k, α. Each such derivative is square integrable in time in spatial supremum norm.
